## Problem

A person or business has a specific home, family, financial, digital-security, personal-safety, property-stability, relationship, connectivity or business-safety pain and needs the smallest appropriate Raven Nexus capability rather than a forced full-suite purchase.

## Inputs

Plain-language pain plus optional audience: home, business or both.

## Outputs

Pain-ranked Raven capabilities with availability, independent sellability, verified-offer state, direct-checkout presence, human-gate requirements, safety boundaries and optional expansion capabilities.

## Pricing

Varies by matched modular capability. The live pain router is the authority for current availability, offer and checkout state; do not invent a price.

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: public Raven Nexus pain router accepts plain-language pain and returns the smallest appropriate modular capability with evidence-state and checkout boundaries.

Discovery and pain matching are read-only. A returned checkout link is not payment proof, and consequential safety or financial actions keep their own human gates.

Payment authority: Raven Nexus / Evercraft Payments where a specific matched offer is verified; the pain router has no silent payment authority.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
